
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(terra)
library(tmap)
library(here)
library(sf)
```

## Prepare the data

```{r}
eez <- st_read('data/wc_regions') # West Coast Economic zones

bathy <- rast('data/depth.tif') # Depth Raster

sst2008 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif')
sst2009 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif')
sst2010 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif')
sst2011 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif')
sst2012 <- rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')

sst <- c(sst2008, sst2009, sst2010, sst2011, sst2012) # Surface Temperatures for each year 2008-2012
```

## Explore

```{r}
tm_shape(eez) +
    tm_polygons()

tm_shape(bathy) +
    tm_raster()

tm_shape(sst) +
    tm_raster()

crs(eez) == crs(bathy) & crs(eez) == crs(sst) 

ext(eez) == ext(bathy) & ext(eez) == ext(sst)
```

## Process the data

Average the SST across 2008-2012 and convert to Celsius

```{r}
sstmean <- mean(sst) - 273.15 
```

Crop extent of depth raster to match that of SST raster

```{r}
ext(bathy) <- ext(sst)raster
```

Resample the depth data to match the resolution of the SST data using the bilinear method approach

```{r}
bathy_resample <- resample(bathy, sstmean, method = 'bilinear')
```

check that the depth and SST match in resolution, extent and CRS

```{r}
ext(bathy_resample) == ext(sstmean) &
crs(bathy_resample) == crs(sstmean) &
res(bathy_resample) == res(sstmean)
```

## Find suitable locations

reclassify SST and depth data into locations that are suitable for oysters (make suitable = 1 and unsuitable = 0)

```{r}
# Subset sst to 11-30 degrees celsius
sstsuit <- sstmean
sstsuit[sstsuit > 30 | sstsuit < 11] <- 0
sstsuit[sstsuit > 0] <- 1

tm_shape(sstsuit) +
    tm_raster()

# Subset depth to 0-70 meters below sea level

bathysuit <- bathy_resample
bathysuit[bathysuit < 0 | bathysuit > 70] <- 0
bathysuit[bathysuit > 0] <- 1

tm_shape(bathysuit) +
    tm_polygons()
```

find locations that satisfy both SST and depth conditions
